messages:
ana: FYI planning a late-night unpin: runtime -> 2.17 (unpin hosted canary) to pick up microkernel perf wins. Change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. We saw a regression on long-context quant workloads in ap-southeast in perf lab. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/issue/2849
greg: Thanks. Need explicit rollout plan + rollback gates. Ops owning watch? @ops-sre?
ops-sre: I'll own monitoring/rollback. Rollback triggers: sustained p99 > baseline*1.5 for 10m OR customer_error_rate increase > 0.6% for 5m. On trigger deploybot will pin runtime=2.16 for the affected cohort and page #incidents/@oncall.
mina: Recommend super-small initial cohort (3%) for 15m smoke, then 25% then ramp. Also carve out "quant-longseq" model-tag to stay on pinned runtime as a safety net.
yauri: SDK compatibility note: SDK 4.x uses early-kvcache-warm hints which might behave differently under the new kernel. Propose server honors header `X-RW-LEGACY-KV` for legacy warm semantics. Will add to SDK changelog and sample code.
nana: (typo) Ana: plan: 02:00 start -> 3% for 15m smoke -> 25% for 30m -> 100% at +80m if green. Release notes draft: https://notes.internal/rel-2849812345 (will include compat header instructions).
greg: Ops checklist: enable feature flag `unpin.284981` and tracing `kvcache.canary`. Increase tracing retention to 4h for the window. Add metric `canary.unpin.p99_delta`.
deploybot: schedule created by @ana. job id deploy-2849812345-01. To cancel: `/deploy cancel deploy-2849812345-01`. Rollback policy attached to job metadata.
ops-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
# quick rollback
if (p99_now >= p99_baseline * 1.5 for 10m) or (cust_error_rate >= 0.006 for 5m):
  deploybot pin runtime=2.16 cohort=canary
  post "runtime unpin rollback" to #incidents with links to traces and top-20 traces
  escalate to eng-runtime and eng-ml oncall
  cut immediate postmortem doc if rollback happens
```
mina: QA: please run longseq (quant-long) + burst tests against the canary path at /qa/longseq/2849. I'll run smoke after 3% step and share results. Also watch first-byte times for early-warm clients.
yauri: I'll prepare a tiny SDK patch that auto-adds `X-RW-LEGACY-KV` for flagged customers; will hold off releasing unless rollback/compat issues surface.
greg: Customer comms: tagging @support and @product to prepare canned responses and status page template in case we need to notify tenants.
ops-sre: We'll also pin a small percentage of global traffic to the old runtime for the first hour as a throttled fallback.
mina: Can we add an internal header flag for tracing cohort: `X-RW-COHORT: unpin-284981`? That will help slice traces easily.
a: ana: done, will ensure header is set for cohort.
deploybot: automated note: step1 (3%) scheduled at 2849816100, job deploy-2849812345-01 queued.
ops-sre: standing by to post first smoke status ~02:20 UTC. Please ack if you are monitoring.
nana: ack
mina: ack
yauri: ack
greg: ack
